cases.name: clean-structured
cases.description: SPEC §2.5: static system + messages, no detector hits -> ok, no advisories.

prompt.system: You are a concise assistant for the ACME internal wiki. Answer from the provided context only.

messages.content: And how do I request one?

cases.name: no-system-advisory
cases.description: SPEC §2.5: structured prompt with 2+ messages and no system/tools block -> the no-system advisory.

messages.content: You are a translator. Translate to French.

advisories: No system block: shared static instructions in a system block form the classic cacheable unit.

cases.name: dynamic-in-system
cases.description: SPEC §2.5: a timestamp inside the system block -> finding + the findings_in_system advisory.

prompt.system: You are a scheduling assistant. The current time is 2026-08-14T10:22:33Z. Be brief.

findings.excerpt: ...are a scheduling assistant. The current time is 2026-08-14T10:22:33Z. Be...
findings.why: Phrase signaling an injected 'current date/time' — the value next to it changes every day or every call.
findings.hint: Inject 'today' only in the final user message, or round to the day and accept a daily cold write.

findings.excerpt: ...istant. The current time is 2026-08-14T10:22:33Z. Be brief.\n\nuser: When is m...
findings.why: A full datetime changes every call — everything after it can never match byte-for-byte.
findings.hint: Remove it, round it to a coarse bucket (day/hour), or move it into the final user message (after the cached prefix).

advisories: 2 dynamic value(s) inside the system block — the system block should be fully static.

cases.name: template-slots-string
cases.description: SPEC §2.5: template slots and an injected date in a string prompt -> blocking findings with per-kind hints.

input.prompt: Summarize ticket {ticket_id} for user {user_name}. Today is 2026-01-02.

findings.excerpt: user: Summarize ticket {ticket_id} for user {user_name}. Today...
findings.why: Python .format()/f-string style placeholder — a per-call value will land here. (If this is literal JSON/code content, ignore.)
findings.hint: Template slot: keep per-call slots at the tail; slots filled with the SAME value every call are harmless.

findings.why: ISO date — if injected as 'today', it breaks the cache at every day boundary. (A static historical date is fine — ignore if so.)
findings.hint: If this is an injected 'today', move it to the tail; if it's static content, ignore this finding.

cases.name: clean-string
cases.description: SPEC §2.5: a plain static string -> ok; string prompts never get the no-system advisory.
